steps.name: header helpers
one header button, shown right before jellyfin-web's search button (phone home)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = __hb.state(); return s.count === 1 && s.shown === 1 && s.nativeShown && s.before ? s : false; })()

steps.name: the header fits the screen
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.skinHeader .headerRight'); const buttons = [...r.children].filter(c => c.getClientRects().length > 0).map(c => __hb.box(c)); return { width: innerWidth, right: Math.max(...buttons.map(b => b[0] + b[2])), left: Math.min(...buttons.map(b => b[0])), ours: __hb.box(__hb.ours()[0]), noHScroll: __hb.noHScroll() }; })()
